name: Lemon Herb White Bean Salad
ingredients: 100 g firm tofu or 60 g low-fat feta, cubed
¼ cup each parsley and mint, chopped
Dressing: 2 tsp olive oil, juice and zest of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove (grated), salt, pepper
steps: Whisk the dressing in a large bowl.
Add the beans, tomatoes and onion and toss gently.
Fold in the tofu and herbs.
note: Quick and make-ahead friendly; keeps for two days in the fridge.
